checks.note: The only comparison is a one-time start-up id check by the agent about itself. It covers image digest, harness version/sha and config files. No drift job compares running network policies, MCP server lists, permissions or self-hosted weights against the approved baseline, and none compares the live cluster state at all.
No scheduled, admission-webhook or change-event drift check exists. The only trigger is a manual deploy workflow. The only CronJob is the reminders job, which does no drift detection.
A mismatch only logs an error and increments a metric, then start-up continues with setAgentTypeId(typeId). There is no block, quarantine or rollback, no response configured, and no time limit.
